task_description: Replicate for PRIMARY (STD4 / Darasa la IV) schools exactly what was done for SECONDARY: source the Mwanza council-level (MWANZA CC ...) and region-level (MKOA ... / ... STD4 2026) primary Mock 2026 summary PDFs from https://sars.ac.tz/results/exam/matokeo-darasa-la-iv-mock-mkoa/2026/mwanza/mwanza-cc-1787231849, store them under primary_council_pdf/ and primary_region_pdf/, zip them as primary_council_pdf.zip / primary_region_pdf.zip (mirroring council_pdf.zip / region_pdf.zip), and build self-contained data-driven HTML+CSS -> WeasyPrint PDF report generators under reports/primary/{council,region}/<primary-level-plus-function>/ mirroring the secondary conventions exactly (own template.html.j2, own style.css with inline @font-face and single family names / no fallback chains, data.json as display strings, reference/original.pdf, generated output/). Each report's palette is measured PER REPORT from its own original (scripts/measure_fills.py) and its grid topology from scripts/measure_grid.py; only the competency-level cell colour is data-driven (sars_pdf/grading.py, extended to recognise the Swahili 'Daraja X (...)' primary grade labels in addition to 'Grade X'). Wire the primary reports into scripts/build_all.py and scripts/render_and_compare.py, and produce reports/primary/INDEX.md with the >=96% PASS/FAIL verdict in the same format as reports/secondary/INDEX.md. Preserve the lakezone success example and all secondary reports unchanged. Real fonts, no fallbacks; honest fidelity reporting with the documented metric-compatible-Liberation residual.
